youtubeTitle: GTA 6 Coffee Launch: Leonida Blend Available Now
socialHook: Officially licensed GTA 6 coffee, the Leonida blend, is now on sale in Miami for $23 per 10‑oz bag.

sections.heading: GTA 6 Coffee Partnership Details
paragraphs: Gamespot reports that Vice City Bean has partnered with Rockstar Games to release the officially licensed GTA 6 Leonida coffee blend, a medium roast made from Colombian and Ethiopian beans, priced at $23 for a 10‑ounce bag, with options for ground, medium or fine grind, and limited availability ahead of the November 19 launch.

sections.heading: Marketing Context and Release Timeline
paragraphs: Gamespot notes that the coffee launch is part of Rockstar’s extensive, controversial marketing push for GTA 6 in Miami, highlighting the game’s Vice City inspiration, while the title remains slated for release on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, though exact timing beyond the date has not been confirmed.
